summary: GreenTree Hospitality Group Ltd., a China-based hotel and restaurant operator, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited second-quarter 2026 financial results. Total revenues declined 18.7% year over year to RMB235.1 million; operating income was RMB48.2 million, and net income fell to RMB21.3 million from RMB160.0 million in the prior-year quarter. Core net income rose 4.4% to RMB47.2 million. Operational metrics deteriorated, with hotel RevPAR down 9.1%. The filing contains only routine earnings disclosures with no special-situation activity, such as an acquisition, strategic review, or tender offer.
